test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Jyotiba Phule was remembered on his birth anniversary on 11th April 2025 for which of the following major contributions to Indian society?

options.text: Founding the first girls’ school in India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Founding the first girls’ school in India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jyotiba Phule** (also known as Jyotirao Phule) was a prominent **social reformer, educationist, and activist** from India.
 
• He is best remembered for his pivotal role in **promoting education for women** and the marginalized sections of society.
 
• In 1848, along with his wife **Savitribai Phule**, Jyotiba Phule founded the **first girls' school in India** in Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• This was a revolutionary step during an era when **women's education** was considered taboo and women were denied basic rights.
 
• Jyotiba Phule also worked tirelessly to eradicate the deeply entrenched **caste system** and promote **social equality**.
 
• He was a vocal critic of the **Brahmanical social order** and sought to uplift the **Dalits and other marginalized communities**.
 
• The establishment of the girls' school marked the beginning of a **new era in women’s education** in India and paved the way for future reforms in the field of education.
 
• His efforts earned him the title of **Mahatma**, meaning "Great Soul."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Launching India’s first cooperative bank**__

 __
 
• The first cooperative bank in India was the **Anyonya Co-operative Bank**, founded in 1889 in Baroda, Gujarat.
 
• While Jyotiba Phule was a social reformer, he was not associated with the establishment of a cooperative bank.
 
 
 
• **Writing the Indian Constitution**__
 __
 
• The **Indian Constitution** was drafted by the **Constituent Assembly of India**, chaired by **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**.
 
• Jyotiba Phule passed away in **1890**, long before the Constitution was written (1947-1949).
 
 
 
• **Leading the 1857 revolt**__
 
 
• The **1857 revolt**, also known as the **First War of Indian Independence**, was led by figures like **Mangal Pandey, Rani Lakshmibai, Tatya Tope, and Bahadur Shah Zafar**.
 
• Jyotiba Phule was a contemporary of the revolt but was more focused on **social reforms** and education rather than armed rebellion.
